label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_01
text: So [VAR 0x0101(0001)] came to our age through\nthe time machine...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_02
text: Then it lived here awhile with the professor?\nAlong with another one of its kind?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_01
text: That seems to be the story.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_03
text: So we...brought it back home, kind of! Or to its\nsecond home, at least![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_02
text: I guess this place should be familiar to it, sure.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_04
text: Awww, that’s great! A chance to unwind and bask\nin the familiarity![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_friend_01
text: That...doesn’t exactly jibe with how it’s been\nacting all spooked since we got here.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_friend_02
text: It doesn’t seem eager to come out of its ball\nanytime soon, either.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_05
text: Really? I thought it was just scared ’cause we\nwere so high up.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_friend_03
text: Huh? Who said it was scared of heights?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_04
text: Given how [VAR 0x0101(0001)] was acting earlier...\nI think something bad happened to it here.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_05
text: Sometimes you get all shaky just seeing a place\nthat you’ve got bad memories of...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_06
text: It was the same for me when I was being ignored\nby everyone in my class.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_07
text: Just thinking about school made me want to hide\naway somewhere... So I know how it feels.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_friend_04
text: So...maybe it got hurt down here in Area Zero,\njust like Mabosstiff?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_08
text: We can’t know for sure, but...it doesn’t change\ninto its battle form anymore, right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_09
text: So I think it’s possible.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_07
text: But that’s so sad! We gotta do something to\nmake it feel better![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_rival_08
text: And no, I’m NOT just saying that ’cause I super\nbadly wanna battle [VAR 0x0101(0001)] myself![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_botan_10
text: ...Seriously? Well, at least you said it and not\none of us.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_06_friend_05
text: Nemona, you’re...kind of unbelievable. In a\nmostly good way.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
